outfits.name: Ashen Crown
outfits.description: Soot-black plate, a burnt cloak and an iron circlet: the prince who walked out of the fire.

outfits.name: Field Marshal
outfits.description: A grey officer's greatcoat, brass buttons and a map case. She plans the war now.

outfits.name: Winter Ranger
outfits.description: A fur-lined mantle, pale leathers and a birch bow, dressed for the northern passes.

outfits.name: Hollow Sun Vestments
outfits.description: Ivory and gold vestments stitched with the eclipsed sun she has seen in every vision.

outfits.name: Black Banner
outfits.description: Gunmetal cavalry plate and a black pennant. The banner rides with no house behind it.

outfits.name: Storm Rider
outfits.description: Slate scale and storm-blue enamel, a rider who comes in ahead of the weather.

outfits.name: Old Guard
outfits.description: Dented bronze from an older war, an open helm and a tower shield. Worn and proud.
